contract.playback: Effective parts record each pose separately. Pose transition replaces part transition. Active entry arrays replace their first value; completed entry restarts explicit arrays. Repeating active entry first finishes one cycle then clears and loops via animateSequence. Hold completion. Clear deletes playback/pose state, releases svgEffect and restores normal d and paint styles.
contract.returnGuard: A transform return is registered only when that target has an inline transform. Paint returns still run. Native paint forwards repeat but not repeatType; d forwards only duration, ease and delay. Opacity with explicit type spring uses the separate Motion svgEffect branch.
